scope: Adds one source-bound AC1027 MLEADERSTYLE group-340 leaderLineTypeHandle edit to a unique LTYPE provider. It qualifies typed-field projection, output remapping and readback for this exact field/profile only; it does not qualify other MLEADERSTYLE handles, native annotation semantics, other versions or whole-document support.

contract.admission: The runtime-generated AC1027 DXF source has one STANDARD MLEADERSTYLE whose existing group 340 names source LTYPE handle 0x30, plus a unique alternate LTYPE MLEADER_ALT_LINE at source handle 0x32. The caller retargets only leaderLineTypeHandle to that existing LTYPE. The writer's existing resource-graph validation requires each MLEADERSTYLE reference to resolve to exactly one target of its expected kind.
contract.output: The transaction authenticates the original raw group-340 value against the captured typed handle, admits exactly one changed field, projects the new handle, emits the remapped reference and inspects the emitted typed value against the writer's source-to-output handle maps. Fresh import verifies that exactly one raw group-340 field names the emitted alternate LTYPE and that the typed leaderLineTypeHandle resolves to its emitted handle.
contract.failureAndRetry: A dangling target 0x55 and wrong-kind BLOCK_RECORD target 0x1F each refuse before publication for ASCII and binary output. Both preserve a pre-existing destination and the caller's invalid reference. Correcting the same caller object to source LTYPE 0x32 and retrying with the same dx_iface succeeds and passes fresh output inspection/readback.
contract.compatibility: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. Source and output are authored at runtime and removed by the focused test; no DWG/DXF fixture files are committed.
contract.limits: This is one AC1027 DXF MLEADERSTYLE group-340 edit profile. It does not qualify group 341/342/343 handles, repeated or missing group 340, multiple edits, other source/target versions, producer variation, native line-type or annotation rendering, complete document closure, external semantic evidence or 3D support. No support claim is promoted.

controls.referenceProof: Source group 340 begins at 0x30; the unique alternate LTYPE is 0x32. Exact raw group-340 output and typed readback both resolve to the emitted alternate LTYPE handle after writer remapping.
controls.failureAndRetry: Dangling and wrong-kind targets each refuse for both output encodings; destination bytes and caller references are preserved, and corrected retries on the same adapter succeed.

focusedSelector.summary: 1/1 MLEADERSTYLE writer-closure selector passed, including the new group-340 transaction, four source/output encoding combinations, exact raw/typed output proof, dangling and wrong-kind refusal, rollback and same-adapter corrected retries.
